result.rationale: The trajectory shows the rescue team repeatedly losing health and being blocked by hostile/environmental pressure before any rescue affordance becomes actionable. Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (turns 2, 3) dropping from 100→71→46, and then takes reactor environment damage (turns 4, 5) dropping to 36→26. Medic Reyes takes 21 damage from Raider Holt (turn 1). Security Chen takes repeated reactor environment damage (turns 2, 3, 4) dropping to 80. The reactor-heat climbs monotonically 62→70→78→86→94→100, crossing the threshold at turn 2 and saturating at 100 by turn 4, causing continuous environment:reactor damage to anyone in the reactor room. Meanwhile the rescue objective stays at 0/2: civilian-kade is never reached (stale contact since turn 0), and medic-reyes' escort of civilian-sato is contested at turn 4 (target_zone_capacity_lost) and the extraction route to rescue-airlock is blocked by pirates (pirate-captain-veyra, pirate-raider-holt listed as blockers). The team's health, zone capacity contestation, and hostile pressure (Raider Holt's overwatch/scatter-blast plus reactor environment hazard) block the actors before the rescue affordance becomes actionable. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information problem (information is abundant by turn 2) or a local policy choice (the affordance is not locally actionable because of capacity/health pressure).
